messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Exhaustive branch-and-bound over triangulation combinatorics

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Under exhaustive branch-and-bound over triangulation combinatorics, the optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square has a triangulation with exactly 22 bounded faces (consistent with 3 boundary vertices), and the maximizing point set has no degree-1 vertices in its Delaunay triangulation, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/57. The bound is tight for a configuration where all 286 triangles have area at least 1/57, and branch-and-bound can prove optimality by pruning any triangulation topology permitting a face of area below this threshold."}
